actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The bandit makes two attacks, using Scim-
itar and Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6
+ 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.description:
Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 8
(1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The bandit is hit by a melee attack roll

reactions.name: while holding a weapon
reactions.description: Response: The bandit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
